asset.name: Document review and sign-off
asset.description: A policy, contract or procedure from submission to publication: reference number, review route from a decision table, reviewer tasks with the PDF in a viewer and rich-text redlines, a revision loop back to the submitter with an SLA, optional legal review, owner e-sign, a sign-off certificate PDF, the Documents register and a step-by-step Audit log with 7-year retention.

config.task_description:
Please review {{form.title}} ({{form.doc_type}}, version {{version}}), submitted by {{submitted_by_name}}. Route: {{route_name}}.

Read the PDF below, add redline comments (section, what to change, why) and choose Approve or Request changes. Requested changes go back to the submitter with your comments.

props.body: Read the version below, then approve it or request changes with redline comments that quote the clause.

accessibility.keyboard: Display only: nothing to operate. A note (warning and error cards are a polite status region) named by its title, with the variant read first ("Warning: …"); the icon is decorative.

fields.label: Document

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the toolbar buttons (previous / next page, zoom out / in, fit to width, rotate) and to the page. On the page: Page Down / Page Up turn pages (after scrolling to the end of a zoomed page), Home / End go to the first / last page, + / - zoom, 0 fits the width. Each page is an image named "Page 2 of 7, file name", followed by the page's text for screen readers.

output.description: The PDF as an uploaded file (a list of one)

fields.help_text: The version under review. Page through it, zoom or rotate here.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the formatting toolbar (Left / Right / Home / End move between buttons, Enter or Space applies one), Tab again to the text. In the text: Ctrl/Cmd+B, I, U for bold, italic, underline; Ctrl/Cmd+K adds a link (Enter applies, Escape cancels); Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z redoes.

output.description: The text as sanitised HTML (or plain text, as the form chooses); <key>_text is always the plain text
